title: marsdawn open --json: success
description: Printed on stdout as one line when `marsdawn open --json` succeeds (exit code 0). marsdawn 0.3.0 and later.

path.description: Absolute path of the file that was opened.

line.description: The line MarsDawn was asked to land on. Present only when one was asked for.

opened.description: The files that were opened, in the order given.

app.description: Path of the MarsDawn app that opened them.

path.description: Absolute path of the folder MarsDawn was asked to show in the window's sidebar.

requested.description: Always true: open handed the folder to MarsDawn and returned.

status.description: What happened to the folder. Present only from a MarsDawn that reports back (marsdawn 0.5.3 and later, paired with an app that declares it) and a --wait above 0. needsUser means the user has to act; see waitingFor. unknown means the app didn't answer before --wait ran out.

waitingFor.description: Present only alongside status "needsUser": what the user has to do. Don't retry; tell them.

folder.description: Present only when --folder, or a directory argument, named a folder to show in the sidebar.
